summary: Comprehensive UI/functionality testing for Azories AI Story Creator. All 6 test features verified. Login works with test@printtest.com/printtest. Navbar links visible. Library shows 76 book cards with Read/Listen buttons on hover. Book Reader displays correctly with navigation controls, image loading, and audio features. AI Stories page has mode toggle (Kids/Studio) and form elements. Mobile view (375px) shows no overlapping buttons.

issues: Onboarding modal 'Create Your Stories' appears frequently and can block interactions - user must dismiss it via 'Get Started' button

critical_code_review_comments: Auth page has 'Keep me signed in for 30 days' checkbox - good UX
PWA prompt 'Get the Full Screen Experience' appears on mobile - good progressive enhancement
Book reader has comprehensive controls: voice selection, speed, auto mode, ambient sounds
Library uses session storage caching for book data - good performance optimization
seed_data_creation: N/A - Used existing test account and book 'The Dragon's Secret Garden' (fb341971-71be-4c8a-b764-a7cac7fb9a71)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All UI features working correctly. Onboarding modal appears frequently but can be dismissed via 'Get Started' button. Test book: fb341971-71be-4c8a-b764-a7cac7fb9a71. Auth route is /auth (not /login).

1_auth_login.notes: Login with test@printtest.com/printtest works. User 'Print Test User' visible in navbar with 9 credits after login. Redirects to /library after successful login.

2_nav_links.notes: All navbar links visible and functional: Library (/library), My Books (/dashboard), AI Stories (/ai-stories), Image Creator, Pro Studio. Navigation works correctly.

3_library_books.notes: Library page shows 76 book cards with covers. 'Read' and 'Listen' buttons appear on hover. Book cards are clickable and navigate to reader. Featured/Best of Week badges visible.

4_ai_stories.notes: AI Stories page loads with mode toggle ('A Child' / 'Older Readers'). Form elements present: Book Title, Character Name, Character Description, Story Description, Age Range, Pages, Art Style. '3 free stories remaining' indicator visible. Quick start templates available.

5_book_reader.notes: Book reader opens correctly. Cover page shows book title and Read/Listen buttons. Page navigation (< >) works. Page counter shows 1/10. Story text and images display correctly. Audio controls: voice selection (Rachel American), speed (0.75x-2x), Auto OFF. 'Order Printed Copy' button visible. 'Ambient' sound option available.

6_mobile_375px.notes: Mobile view at 375px width: NO overlapping buttons detected. Book cover fits screen. Read/Listen buttons properly spaced. Reading page shows image and text without overflow. Navigation buttons (< >) centered at bottom. PWA install prompt appears at bottom.
